_note: HAND-AUTHORED signature content promoted to source layer. Not compiler output.

special.name: DRUNKEN LAUNCHER KICK
special.subtitle: he falls on purpose
special.identity: The mistake that wasn't a mistake.
special.animationIntent: STUMBLE — he appears to fall forward and the opponent reads a whiff. At the last frame the hips rotate and the kick launches. GOVERNOR RULE: if this reads as clean or professional, it has FAILED. It must look wrong before it looks like genius.
special.vfx_intent: low dust ring, no flash — the launch should surprise
special._variance_law: VOLUME 18: 'Startup: variable. Cannot always repeat the same timing.' The engine rolls startup in [startup-variance, startup+variance] from the seeded match RNG. Deterministic per match (replay-safe), unrepeatable within one.
special._governor_rule: If the kick looks clean and professional: FAIL.

specialF.name: CHAKRA RUSH
specialF.subtitle: the body makes it
specialF.animationIntent: RUSH — aura compresses feet -> legs -> torso -> fists, then the body goes. Afterimages and ghost impacts trail him. Energy never leaves the body.
specialF.vfx_intent: trail generated at the body, not thrown from the hand
specialF._law: VOLUME 18: cannot become projectile zoning. This move spawns NO projectile and has no independent hitbox — all damage is carried by the body during the rush. Elastic aggression, aura pressure. If it ever gains a projectile it stops being Chakra Rush.

blockbuster.name: FULL DECK
blockbuster.subtitle: fifty-two ways to lose
blockbuster.identity: Fifty-two cards leave his hand at speeds and angles he never sets. The spread is genuinely wide — this move does not aim. It floods. The opponent is not beaten by a read; they are beaten by there being nowhere left to stand.
blockbuster._rule_answer: Question 1 — does this move express chaos? YES. It is the only move in his kit with randomised velocity and spread. It is the chaos state's thesis as a super: he wins without ever deciding where to hit.
blockbuster.animationIntent: LAUGH — the throw is loose, the wrist never locks. He is not watching where they go.
blockbuster.sound: fifty-two impacts, none of them rhythmic

maniac.name: 35 ARM RUSH
maniac.subtitle: you were being studied
maniac.identity: Brooklyn attacks so unpredictably the opponent cannot visually process the sequence. When it ends, the chaos is gone.
maniac.animationIntent: The arms outrun the eye — layered afterimages, continuous forward pressure. On the final frame the body STOPS being loose. The stance settles into Predator Flow and does not move again.
maniac.vfx_intent: afterimage stack; the silence after is the point

throw.name: DECK_SMASH
throw.subtitle: fifty-two pickup
throw.purpose: confirmed damage, hard knockdown, corner carry
throw.identity: He does not set up the throw. He takes your collar mid-conversation, shows you a banana you did not agree to, and puts you through the floor.
throw.animationIntent: CRASH — contact is casual, the slam is not. He never stops smiling.
throw.sound: collar grab, a beat of nothing, then the floor

throwF.name: UPPERCARD
throwF.subtitle: the house always wins
throwF.purpose: launcher throw, converts to air pressure
throwF.identity: He lifts you by the jaw on the back of one hand, like dealing a card off the bottom.
throwF.animationIntent: FLOURISH — the lift is a card trick. Wrist does the work.

special.name: FLOW PUNCH
special.subtitle: the intercept
special.identity: Former wild punch. Now a perfect intercept — Jeet Kune Do, the stop-hit.
special.animationIntent: READ — he does not swing at where they are. He arrives where they will be. Perfect posture, no wind-up.
special.vfx_intent: no flourish — a single clean line

specialF.name: HUNTER STEP
specialF.subtitle: footwork, not teleportation
specialF.identity: Brooklyn disappears from normal rhythm. Not teleportation — footwork mastery.
specialF._law: VOLUME 18: must read as martial footwork, never as a teleport. No flash, no vanish, no particle burst at origin. Ground contact must remain visible throughout.
specialF.animationIntent: REDIRECT — Capoeira angle into the blind side. Feet never leave the floor for long. He is simply not where the beat expected.
specialF.sound: two footfalls where there should be four

blockbuster.name: DRAGON CHAKRA BARRAGE
blockbuster.subtitle: every strike is a wave
blockbuster.identity: Former 35 ARM RUSH. Now every strike creates a controlled energy wave. Same arms, same count — but nothing is wasted and nothing is random.
blockbuster.animationIntent: CHAIN — controlled aura waves on every strike. Structured, repeating, inevitable. The opposite of FULL DECK in every way except the arm count.
